test_overview: Evaluated the board-revert test plan against a collaborative whiteboard app. Steps 1-3 passed completely (32/32): board setup with name prompt and Connected indicator, four distinct actions with strictly increasing history numbers, revert confirmation dialog with proper cancel (no-op) and confirm (canvas restored exactly to post-action-#2 state verified via pixel checks; history trimmed and new revert entry #5 appended without reusing numbers; subsequent green draw numbered #6; latest entry lacks revert control). Step 4 FAILED fatally: while the app correctly blocked reverts when disconnected (no dialog/no effect in 'Reconnecting...' state), after restoring connectivity (status 'Connected') a confirmed revert to action #2 did not apply - no new revert history entry appeared and the canvas remained pixel-identical even after waiting. Per fatal-failure rules, evaluation stopped and step 5 was not executed. Total: 32/52.

steps.description: test_setup_distinct_action_sequence: Redirect to /b/{editToken} OK; name prompt handled ('Tester'); Connected indicator and History panel present. Drew black line (#1), red intersecting line (#2), erase at intersection (#3 'Erased part of the board'), blue scribble (#4) - each created a history entry within ~5s; numbers strictly increasing (1,2,3,4); canvas showed all four edits with broken intersection. All verifications passed.

test_revert_confirmation_and_canvas_restoration: 'Revert to here' on #2 opened a confirmation dialog (PASS). Cancel left canvas pixel-identical and history intact (#3,#4 present). Confirm restored canvas exactly to post-#2 state - red line continuous through intersection, black line intact, blue mark absent - and history became #5 'Reverted board to action #2', #2, #1. All passed.

test_history_timeline_after_revert: Entries #3/#4 no longer visible; revert entry #5 present with number > BLUE_MARK_ACTION(4), no reuse; new green draw created entry #6 (>5, no reuse); canvas showed reverted state plus green mark, no discarded content; latest entry #6 had 'Latest' badge and no revert control. All (non-fatal) verifications passed.

test_revert_blocked_while_disconnected: Offline simulation produced 'Reconnecting...' status and disabled toolbar; revert attempt while disconnected was a proper no-op (canvas/history unchanged) - passed. After restoring connectivity ('Connected' shown), initiated revert to #2 and confirmed the dialog, but the revert never applied: history remained #6,#5,#2,#1 with no new revert entry and canvas stayed pixel-identical (green mark retained) even after waiting. FATAL verification 'Revert succeeds while Connected' FAILED -> 0 points and evaluation stops.
test_revert_propagates_to_viewer_and_board_isolation: NOT EXECUTED - evaluation stopped due to the fatal failure in step 4 (confirmed revert while Connected did not take effect).
